Up to 48 hours total playback: Get up to 10 hours of playtime plus 30 hours from the case with ANC on, or up to 12 hours plus 36 hours with ANC off. Water- and dust-resistant design: Built for daily use with an ergonomic fit for lasting comfort on the go. Customizable listening: Use the JBL Headphones app and Personi-Fi 3.0 to tailor your sound experience. Protective carrying case included: Expo Gear weather-resistant hard-shell case features compact protection, a smooth zipper closure, built-in mesh pocket, and included carabiner for easy travel. From commuting and workouts to work calls and weekend trips, this JBL Tune Buds 2 bundle gives you versatile wireless sound and practical protection wherever the day takes you.
